cases.sentence: У них ушло на это сорок дней, потому что таков ___ бальзамирования.
cases.explain: «полный срок» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Forty days were used for him, for that is how many the days it takes to embalm. The Egyptians wept for Israel for seventy days.

cases.sentence: Они пришли к ___ Атада, что за Иорданом, и там стали громко и горько плакать.
cases.explain: «молотильной площадке» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: They came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and severe lamentation. He mourned for his father seven days.

cases.sentence: Когда хананеи, обитатели той земли, увидели плач у ___ Атада, они сказали: «У египтян великий плач и горе».
cases.explain: «молотильной площадки» — after the preposition «у», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: When the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, “This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians.” Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.

cases.sentence: Когда хананеи, обитатели той земли, увидели плач у молотильной площадки Атада, они сказали: «У египтян ___ и горе».
cases.explain: «великий плач» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: When the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, “This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians.” Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.
